name: Level_1 - Task_9
description: Load the MACE-MP-0 foundation model as an ASE-compatible atomic calculator. Construct a primitive unit cell of Silicon (Si) in the diamond crystal structure with a lattice parameter a = 5.43 Å. Attach the MACE calculator to the system. First, perform a full geometry optimization of the atomic positions using a quasi-Newton optimizer (e.g., BFGS) until the maximum atomic force is below 0.01 eV/Å. Next, perform a finite-displacement harmonic analysis on the relaxed crystal to evaluate the vibrational frequencies. Programmatically calculate and return the Zero-Point Energy (ZPE) of the system at the Γ-point as a floating-point value in eV. (Ensure you clean up or overwrite any temporary displacement files generated during the finite-displacement analysis).
